brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian and wounded three others near a displacement camp in Mawasi, Khan Younis, Shehab Wire reported. The attack targeted a tent housing displaced persons as Israeli military operations continue across Gaza.

The strike occurred amid ongoing escalation in the territory, where hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have fled their homes since the conflict intensified.

title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian, wounds three near Khan Younis displacement camp
